passed_formula_checks.proof: Upward n at (x,y,z) contributes [0,0,n] and moment [y*n,-x*n,0]. Therefore sum(n)=-Fz; sum(x*n)=My; sum(y*n)=-Mx. The script uses exactly these equations. Its current generated loads are vertical and have zero net yaw moment.

Required actuator torque is minus the projection of all exterior distal moments onto the parent-transformed unit axis. bias=-Mext.dot(axis), coefficient_i=-axis.dot((v_i-J) cross ez) for descendant-owned contact points; ownership masking is required and present.

Extension force on B is +fp*u; retraction is -fm*u. jac=u.dot(axis cross (B-J))=axis.dot((B-J) cross u). Per cylinder endpoints are 0.9*jac*fp and -0.9*jac*fm; summing minima/maxima reproduces negative/positive capacity, including negative jac.
The two rows represent c+k.n <= Cpos*t and -(c+k.n) <= Cneg*t, with n>=0 and t>=0. For the reviewed Cpos,Cneg>0, t<=1 is existence of one common witness within the listed references only.
For min c.x with Ax<=b, Ex=d, x>=0, lambda<=0 and r=c-A.T.lambda-E.T.y>=0 give lower bound b.lambda+d.y. The script checks these signs and the gap consistently.

A=pi*(ro^2-ri^2), I=pi*(ro^4-ri^4)/4 and Jp=2I are annular section properties. |N|/A+M_b*ro/I and |T|*ro/Jp match the uniform isotropic circular-section sensitivity assumption with a unit shaft axis. Builder lines 67-74 define matching moving-shaft radii.

Within each brace there are two separate D16 lock pins at two telescope-overlap stations, each assigned a double-shear reference. Thus 2 locks times 2 planes times A times (355 MPa/sqrt(3)) divided by FS2 is per-brace gross axial reference; outer sum across two braces is separate. D24 fixed/moving endpoint pins are in series and are not included in this expression. No brace/end-pin factor has been counted twice.
passed_formula_checks.required_conditions: Two lock pins share brace axial load ideally; each pin has two effective shear planes; 355 MPa is the material sensitivity; side-wall bearing, ligaments, end pins, stiffness/load sharing, buckling and actual engagement remain unqualified.

data_checks.certificate_balance_target_method: All successful cases compare E*n to the independently generated normal_contact witness and to the finite inventory total vertical force; neutral cases additionally reconstruct all gravity moments and distal bias directly from scene.mass_rows COMs.

scope_observations.text: Child exterior F,M contains gravity/payload/contact, not hydraulic eye forces. Actual interface/shaft section forces require Fshaft=-(Fext+sum(Feye)+other interfaces), Mshaft(J)=-(Mext+sum((B-J) cross Feye)+other interfaces), followed by bearing/support/section partition. LP bounds only generalized torque; multiple cylinder force splits are not solved. No upper or lower actual shaft-stress bound follows.

sqrt(sigma^2+3*tau^2) is valid for a coincident uniaxial-normal-plus-shear stress state. Here sigma/tau sum component magnitudes whose extrema generally occur at different section locations. Output is a combined sensitivity, not the stress at an actual material point. The current missing annular factor also prevents a conservative-profile claim.
The common witness minimizes capacity use t only. Grossshaft sensitivity at it is not maximized/minimized over all feasible contact allocations; solver tie breaking is not a structural extremum.

Both sides use actual_foot_brace_report_left and side is unused. The reviewed builder mirrors the same foot geometry/q and current locked-pose magnitudes agree, so no numeric capacity defect is established for these poses. Right-side details retain left IDs; independent asymmetric right-foot states would require right-derived arms or an explicit symmetry restriction.

lp itself enforces only vertical force and roll/pitch moment equations; unlike normal_contacts it does not reject horizontal loads/yaw. All current generated loads are vertical, so this is a future-domain guard limitation, not an active sign error.

Native unions change volume in four nonneutral poses and fixed inventory mass is reused with posed union COM. Those cases remain COM/material proxies as the source scope states. Three coherent all-low/nominal/all-high profiles are not independent interval worst cases.

No factor-of-two double count is established: first 2=two lock stations/pins per brace, second 2=assumed shear planes, subsequent sum=two separate braces. Full brace capacity cannot be assigned from this gross lock-only reference because D24 end interfaces, bearing/ligaments, engagement, load sharing and stability are unresolved.
